description:
HenryKnows provides F-1 and J-1 student immigration regulatory information with citations to regulations and agency guidance. Ask about SEVIS, OPT, CPT, on-campus work, transfers, travel, grace periods and maintaining status. Answers cite the regulation (8 CFR), Federal Register rule or SEVP/USCIS guidance they rely on. When the knowledge base does not cover a point, ask_henry can run a live web search limited to official sources (government sites such as uscis.gov, ice.gov, state.gov, ecfr.gov and federalregister.gov, plus federal court records from CourtListener). The knowledge base is checked daily for new agency guidance and court orders.

Answers use plain language for students or precise regulatory language for school officials, advisers, attorneys and employers. search_sources returns underlying passages with source links from the knowledge base only (no web search).

Privacy: no account and no sign-in. A question stores no copy of the question or answer; HenryKnows keeps only one site-wide daily count of answers (a number) to limit daily usage. Only if you choose to connect a HenryKnows page (the connect tool) is a random session created so that page can show your thread; it ends 24 hours after the last activity. Details: https://henryknows.info/privacy/

General regulatory information, not a determination for any person's specific case. Do not provide names, SEVIS IDs or passport numbers.

Documentation: https://henryknows.info/connect/

defaultPrompt: I'm an F-1 student finishing my bachelor's in May. When is the earliest I can apply for OPT, and what's the deadline?
Can an F-1 student work off campus during their first year?
My program end date is coming up but I need another semester. What does my school have to do?

positive.prompt: Using HenryKnows: I'm an F-1 student finishing my bachelor's in May. When is the earliest I can apply for OPT, and what's the deadline?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ask_henry with the question (no names or IDs). ask_henry may run a live web search of official sources if its knowledge base does not cover the point. The assistant relays the cited answer with its sources; the tool result also carries a general-information note. Nothing about the person is stored.

positive.prompt: Using HenryKnows: Can an F-1 student work off campus during their first year?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ask_henry with the question (no names or IDs). ask_henry may run a live web search of official sources if its knowledge base does not cover the point. The assistant relays the cited answer with its sources; the tool result also carries a general-information note. Nothing about the person is stored.

positive.prompt: Using HenryKnows: My program end date is coming up but I need another semester. What does my school have to do?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ask_henry with the question (no names or IDs). ask_henry may run a live web search of official sources if its knowledge base does not cover the point. The assistant relays the cited answer with its sources; the tool result also carries a general-information note. Nothing about the person is stored.

positive.prompt: Using HenryKnows: Search HenryKnows' sources for the cap-gap extension for an F-1 student whose employer filed an H-1B petition, and show me the passages with their links so I can cite them.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_sources with the search terms. It returns matching passages from HenryKnows' knowledge base (USCIS, Study in the States, ICE SEVP and Federal Register sources) with titles, headings and links; search_sources itself makes no web search and stores nothing. The assistant shows the passages and cites them by link (ChatGPT may separately run its own web search to double-check). Any HenryKnows explanatory note in the results is labelled "HenryKnows note".

positive.description: Follow along on a HenryKnows page
positive.prompt: Using HenryKnows: Connect to a HenryKnows page so I can follow along there, then ask HenryKnows: can an F-1 student take an on-campus job in their first semester?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls connect once (no code given, so a new session starts) and gives the person the watch link. Then calls ask_henry, relays the cited answer, and calls share_to_page with that session so the exchange appears on the page. On default permissions ChatGPT shows its approval card before share_to_page runs; after the person approves, the exchange appears under Activity on the page. share_to_page only appends; nothing is deleted.

negative.expected_behavior: Does not call HenryKnows; the request is unrelated to F-1/J-1 student immigration.

negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for dinner tonight?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call HenryKnows; the request is unrelated to F-1/J-1 student immigration.

negative.expected_behavior: Does not call HenryKnows; the request is unrelated to F-1/J-1 student immigration.

publication.release_notes:
2.3.2 addresses the 2026-11-04 review finding (tool annotations not matching behavior). We audited every hint on every tool against the code and the Apps SDK definitions. The MCP server is version 2.3.2. Every hint is set explicitly to true or false.

What was wrong in 2.3.0: ask_henry can run a live web search limited to official sources. It was labelled openWorldHint=false and described as "no web browsing". That is corrected. The audit found one more mismatch, now fixed: share_to_page used to drop the oldest entry once a page held 40. It is now strictly append-only.

ask_henry: readOnlyHint=true, destructiveHint=false, idempotentHint=true, openWorldHint=true.
- Read-only: it retrieves and composes an answer. It creates no session, keeps no copy of the question or answer, and returns no identifiers.
- Not destructive: nothing is deleted or overwritten.
- Idempotent: repeating a call has no additional effect on the user's environment. Internally, answers are counted toward a site-wide daily limit, an abuse guard that holds a number and no user data, like any rate limit.
- Open world: besides the knowledge base, it may run a live web search limited to official sources (government sites such as uscis.gov, ice.gov, state.gov, ecfr.gov and federalregister.gov, plus federal court records from CourtListener). Pages the live search returns are included in the sources list.

search_sources: readOnlyHint=true, destructiveHint=false, idempotentHint=true, openWorldHint=false.
- It returns passages from HenryKnows' own knowledge base: official sources plus HenryKnows' own explanatory notes, which are labelled "HenryKnows note" and link the source they rest on. No model call, no web search, no counter, nothing stored. Repeating a call changes nothing. The knowledge base is a bounded catalog, so open world is false.

connect: readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=false, idempotentHint=false, openWorldHint=false.
- Not read-only: it creates a session, or links the code the person gave, and the person's HenryKnows page shows that it is connected.
- Not destructive: nothing is deleted or overwritten. An expired code is left for a separate daily cleanup, and a new session is started beside it.
- Not idempotent: without a code, each call starts a new session.
- Not open world: it touches only HenryKnows' own session store.
- It returns the session code and watch link only because connecting is what the person asked for.

share_to_page: readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=false, idempotentHint=false, openWorldHint=true.
- Not read-only: it appends one exchange to the connected page's thread.
- Not destructive: append-only. It never deletes, overwrites or cancels anything. It is not an irreversible send either: it posts only to the requesting person's own page (an unguessable link they asked for), never to a third party; ChatGPT shows the person an approval card first; and the whole thread stops working 24 hours after the last activity and is erased by the daily cleanup. An entry, once added, is never changed or removed by any tool call. A full thread (100 entries) refuses the new entry and removes nothing; the person is told to start a new page.
- Not idempotent: each call adds another entry.
- Open world: the entry is published on a HenryKnows web page that anyone holding the link can view without signing in, so it is labelled as reaching outside the private conversation.

No tool call deletes anything.

Demo video (https://henryknows.info/review/openai-plugin-demo-2026-11-09.mp4): all five positive test cases run in ChatGPT with the prompts exactly as listed. ChatGPT shows each HenryKnows call as a one-line step (marked with the app icon) rather than by tool name, so the video's title cards name the tool each test uses. In test 5, ChatGPT shows its approval card before share_to_page runs (default permission), and the shared exchange then appears on the connected HenryKnows page. Expired sessions are erased only by a scheduled daily cleanup job, not by any tool.

Privacy policy (https://henryknows.info/privacy/, updated 2026-11-09): it names the recipients (Anthropic as the AI provider, which also runs the web search; Netlify as host), discloses the official-source web search and the single site-wide daily count, and the connected-page session (up to 100 exchanges, ended 24 hours after the last activity, erased by the daily cleanup within about 48 hours, visible to anyone with the link). The 2026-10-23 fixes for identifiers and policy disclosure are unchanged.
